title: Indigenous Tree Planting & Nursery
description: Nurturing native tree seedlings in our community nurseries and planting them across degraded parts of the Elgeyo Marakwet escarpment to prevent landslides and restore forest cover.
ideas: Grow and distribute 5,000 native seedlings by end of the season
Engage local schools in conservation runs and walks
Scale up women-led community tree nurseries

title: Water Trough & Catchment Cleaning
description: Cleaning and restoring rural water troughs used by local residents and livestock. We are brainstorming ways to install simple sand filters and plant indigenous reeds to naturally purify water.
ideas: Restore 3 major community water troughs along key paths
Establish local water user committees for long-term maintenance
Filter out silt and mud to keep local drinking water safe

title: Bridging Tourism & Conservation
description: Designing community-led guided trails along the escarpment where visitors participate directly in planting a tree. We are merging Iten's legendary high-altitude running culture with nature conservation.
ideas: Map out 2 official eco-tourism trails around Iten
Train local youth as eco-guides to share escarpment history
Incorporate conservation milestones directly into runner training camps
